examples: A public park is open.
A public library is free.
The beach is public.

more.def: Open to all people, not private.
examples: The public library lends books to everyone.
A public park is open to the whole town.
The pool is public on Saturdays.
The museum is open to the public.
The public can visit.
The park is for the public.

more.def: People in general, as a group.
examples: The zoo is open to the public every day.
The mayor spoke to the public.
Announcements were made for the public.
Pull the door.
He pulled the wagon.
I pull the rope.

more.def: To take hold of something and move it toward you or after you.
examples: Please pull the door instead of pushing it.
The horses pulled the wagon up the hill.
She pulled a weed out of the garden.

easy.def: To press on something to make it move away.
examples: Push the door open.
I push the swing.
She pushed the cart.

more.def: To press against something to make it move away from you.
examples: She pushed the stroller up the path.
Push the button to start the machine.
He pushed the door open with his shoulder.

easy.def: To set something in a place.
examples: Put the cup on the table.
I put my coat on the hook.
She put the toy away.

more.def: To place something somewhere or to move it into a certain position.
examples: Please put your shoes by the door.
He put the cookies in a jar to keep them fresh.
We put a blanket over the sleeping baby.
